title: Xongolo kak temeete
intro: sabri aydaadu kee waado sinni racmatta yallih qhur'aanal fakkimte. Farmoyta kaxxa magaalah ruubeenim takkay immay ken ummatta digga cineenih numma cineenih. Frustration addat, ta rooci gexeh — dubuk baddi addal qimmoh addah wagitak, qimmoh addah wagitak, qimmoh addah wagitak. Diteh garbak, rammitle xaaqo ugutteeh, Racmattale gacsa yeceeh. iyyaay ta rooci milaagimeh, miyyin ummatta bool alfiik daga takkeh tan diini mara akkeleeh?
clues: Anu maabitina akkuk ruubeh suge kaxxa magaala too sigeenit diini gitak hoxxeh sugte.
Anu inni ummattah qagaaqagitak nummat seece, takkay immay oson yi farmo yoo yisuuleh cineenih.
Anu idni yomcowweemik afal bakcarrat keenik gexeeh, fakut yan badih fanah gexe.
Kaxxa qawwalayla ugutteeh, anu kaadu baddi addal qide — tohuk lakal inkih tan baddi qandeh addat culte.
Dite layers — baddi addat, ginook garba, kee baddi addat — anu edde yaabam: ‘Koo hinnay, rabbi mayan; kunnabna koh takkay; Anu qellat abe marih fanat suge.'
Yalli yoo catteh addah obsal, anu uduure wak bool alfiik daga takke yi ummatta numma oggolteh sugte.

arabic: فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ ءَامَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَآ إِيمَـٰنُهَآ إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّآ ءَامَنُوا۟ كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
verse: Then has there not been a [single] city that believed so its faith benefited it except the people of Jonah? When they believed, We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in worldly life and gave them enjoyment [i.e., provision] for a time. (10:98)
